note: Small campground on US 2 between Marshfield and Plainfield, with grassy sites and mountain views. The Winooski River runs behind it, below a wooded bank, with a sandy beach area for swimming, tubing and kayaking. Pool, playground, rec room and a 150-ft slip-and-slide; tent sites take stays of up to a week. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: 20 sites (12 W/E/S + 2 W/E, 30 A; 6 tent) - stored count 16 -> 20 and electric 50 -> 30. $40 nightly before 9% tax (price gate passes), $240/week, tents $25, monthly $650, seasonal $2,500. Season May 1-Oct 15. Booking by call/text/email with deposit. Google 4.8 (48). Long-stay: about half the RV sites hold trailers before opening; with tent sites, nightly share ~60%+ - keep, no caveat. Waterfront: stays not waterfront (river behind a wooded bank; no photo shows a site view). Pin at the office: fine.
flags: HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived from the old note's '2 with 50A') -> 30; the operator now says '12 WES/ 2 W/E with 30 amp hookup' and 'ELECTRIC/30amp'.
SITES: stored count 16 -> 20 (12 + 2 RV, 6 tent). Stored pull_through true is derived from the old note; the current pages don't mention pull-throughs - left alone, flag only.

LONG-STAY (keep, no caveat): the host invites guests 'whether you are staying for a season or maybe just a few days or a night' and sells monthly ($650) and seasonal ($2,500) sites. Esri imagery of 2024-04-26 (before the May 1 opening) shows ~9 trailers on the 14 RV sites, two of them presumably the park-model and fifth-wheel rentals - so roughly 7 seasonals. With the 6 tent sites and 2 rentals counted as nightly, about 13 of 20 sites (~65%) are nightly.
PRICE GATE: passes - $40 nightly before the 9% tax.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept; no --AWH value): the operator says the campground is 'located along the Winooski River' with 'a sandy beach area with swimming'. Esri 2024 shows the river ~25-40 m east of the southern sites (~44.3212,-72.3807) but beyond a deciduous wooded bank strip, and ~90 m from the northern sites across the pool/playground field. Behind trees with no site photo showing water = at most a view, and no view shown -> stays down. A reviewer with summer photos of the south sites seeing water could make it riverview.
FACILITIES: dropped nothing; added laundry and wifi. Stored had only showers (derived).
PIN: 44.32258,-72.38138 is by the office/house at the north entrance off US 2; the sites run ~200 m south. Fine.
INCLUSION EVIDENCE: describes this campground - fine.
